title: The sharp curl-Sobolev inequality
summary: We solve a longstanding problem, going back at least to Rivière 1998 and open even in the physically most relevant case $n=3$, by proving a sharp curl-Sobolev inequality on $\mathbb{S}^n$ when $n\equiv 3\pmod 4$: for every $\frac{n-1}{2}$-form $α$, the conformally invariant quotient satisfies (with positive denominator) \[ \frac{\Big(\int_{\mathbb{S}^n}|{\rm curl}α|^{\frac{2n}{n+1}}\,{\rm dV}\Big)^{\frac{n+1}{n}}}{\int_{\mathbb{S}^n}\langle{\rm curl}α,α\rangle\,{\rm dV}} \ge \frac{n+1}{2}\,ω_n^{\frac1n}. \] We also classify all extremals in terms of Killing forms.
